n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s2.prompt: Ngatichinje kurongeka here? Pane mabhora 3 mubhokisi. Kana ukatanga waisa mabhora 6 wobva wabvisa mabhora 5, pasara mabhora mangani mubhokisi?
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s2.hint.0: Isa mabhora 3, uye mushure mekuisa 6, tanga wanyora huwandu hwemabhora mubhokisi.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s2.hint.1: Kubva pahuwandu uhwo, dzima zvakawanda sezvaunobvisa, uye uverenge mabhora akasara.

n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s2.r.b: Hauna kuverenga mabhora 6 akaiswa. Tanga wawana huwandu hwemabhora mushure mekuisa 6.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s2.r.d: Kufunga uku kwakawedzera 3, 6, ne 5 zvese pamwe chete. Kana ukabvisa, mabhora anova mashoma.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s2.explain: Kana ukaisa mabhora 6 ne 3, unowana 9, uye kana ukabvisa 5 kubva pa 9, 4 anosara. Kunyange nenhamba dzakafanana, sa 3+6-5, kuchinja kurongeka kunogona kuita kuti mutambo ugoneke.

n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s3.fail.c3: Kunyange ukaisa kutanga, hapana mabhora anokwana ekubvisa, kana hapana asara. Verenga huwandu hwemabhora mushure mekuisa zvakare.
n-m-e1-s2b-05.s.s3.explain: Semuenzaniso, kubva mubhokisi rinotanga ne 2, haugoni kubvisa 4 kutanga, asi kana ukatanga waisa 5, pane 7, uye mushure mekubvisa 4, 3 anosara.
